title: Build the investor list
summary: Gather the people and family offices the sponsor already knows, with how each relationship started, before any offering opens.
outlineSteps: Gather the people and family offices the sponsor already knows
Record how and when each relationship began
Mark who has invested with the sponsor before
Note what the sponsor knew of each contact's finances and investing experience
Record who referred each contact and on what terms
Keep contacts met through public outreach on a separate list
Keep deal terms out of conversations until counsel clears the offering
Limit who can see and change the list
Date the list before any offering opens
